meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 安装后 Claude 会调用 vercel CLI 将应用部署到 Vercel，也能管理项目、域名和环境变量。部署前会先本地构建并做检查，部署后验证线上 URL 是否正常。
howto.when: 当用户要求部署、发布或上线 Web 应用，或要求管理 Vercel 项目、域名、环境变量时触发。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: 会先本地构建，再部署并返回线上地址。

say.text: 查看 Vercel 上 production 环境变量
say.note: 会拉取环境变量到本地 .env 文件。

say.text: 把 example.com 添加到当前 Vercel 项目

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use the Vercel CLI to deploy web apps, manage projects, domains, and environment variables. It runs local build checks first and verifies the live URL after deployment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web app, or manage Vercel projects, domains, or environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Builds locally first, then returns the live URL.

say_en.text: Show production environment variables on Vercel.
say_en.note: Pulls them into the local .env file.

say_en.text: Add example.com to the current Vercel project.
say_en.note: Adds the domain to the project.
